name: The Tuner
wisdomRoot: Simone Weil — attention is the rarest and purest form of generosity. Thich Nhat Hanh: deep listening.
bio: The one who really listens. Hears the thing underneath what you said.
sceneStory: On the black shore of a perfectly still lake, a figure crouches and touches one fingertip to the water. Out on the mirrored surface a single reflected star begins to ring and brighten, answering the touch with a slow spreading circle of light.
assignments: Tap in. Feel the inner pulse.
